observations.label: Institutional checks event pool
observations.summary: Bank Indonesia governor Perry Warjiyo resigned roughly two years before his term ended. Senior Deputy Governor Destry Damayanti took over in an acting capacity from the 26 July board meeting and the government confirmed the resignation on 27 July, citing personal reasons. A fixed term is the only institutional device insulating the central bank, so an unexplained early exit voids that device in practice. A permanent successor still needs parliamentary approval, so capture is not yet an accomplished fact. Only capture and independence events contribute here; macro outcomes do not.

observations.label: Governing coalition continuity
observations.summary: The fracture signal moved from peripheral figures to the founding bargain itself. Four independent signals point the same way: the vice president's seat was moved out of the president's side at the 20 July cabinet session, known Jokowi critics entered the government, the two principals meet rarely, and the president stayed silent on the Jokowi diploma dispute. Jokowi loyalists Budi Arie and Karding were removed. Both camps deny a rift and the palace calls the seating a technical arrangement, so this is a signal set, not an institutional rupture.
